long_biography.plain_text:
Bilgili studied business administration and photography at the University of Redlands, disciplines that later met in his approach to cities. His Portraits of Nişantaşı project placed large-scale photographs of local creative figures on a building façade, using a development site as a temporary public gallery.

That visual interest also informs his restoration work. Beginning with Akaretler Row Houses, the group adapted historic Istanbul buildings for hotels, clubs and mixed-use projects, including Soho House and The Peninsula. Current projects extend the model to residences, offices and heritage sites abroad. Bilgili remains chairman, while a separate chief executive handles day-to-day management.
